scope: Presentation, URL routing and sanitisation; this is not a new network health check of every external service.
findings: Only Instagram used preview-first presentation and bottom attribution.
Only Instagram and YouTube separated official click-through URLs from proxy previews.
Supported platforms omitted some generic and host-specific tracking rules.
Most pasted proxy URLs were not routed back through the official destination logic.
YouTube short-link canonicalization dropped playlist/index and some playback fields.
